name: boka
description: A public fashion-design portfolio — a storefront with nothing to buy.
//dependencies: @opentelemetry/api is here for the Netlify build, not for tracing. Next declares it as an OPTIONAL peer dependency and imports it from the edge runtime; Netlify deploys Next middleware as an edge function and its esbuild bundler tries to resolve the import regardless of the optional marker, failing the build with 'Could not resolve @opentelemetry/api'. This project has middleware (it gates /studio), so the path is unavoidable. Pinned exactly inside Next's ^1.1.0 range. With no exporter configured OpenTelemetry is a no-op, so nothing is traced and nothing leaves the process. Remove it only if middleware is removed or Netlify honours the optional peer.
//overrides: sharp and postcss are forced up because next bundles vulnerable nested copies, and both ship at runtime: sharp parses uploaded images, postcss runs in the build. brace-expansion is deliberately NOT overridden — its advisory is dev-only (eslint plugins, absent from the production tree) and v5 breaks minimatch's API, so forcing it trades a theoretical DoS for a broken linter.
